faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Have a question? Here are the answers to the most common ones.

items.question: How do I book a property on Linkhoo?
items.answer: Choose your country, city and dates, open the property page and send your booking request. You pay for the stay online when you make the request; the manager then confirms availability. If the request is declined or cancelled, the amount is fully refunded. You can also chat with the manager through the built-in messaging.

items.question: How is the rent paid?
items.answer: The stay is paid online at the time of the request, by mobile money through our provider pawaPay. Linkhoo collects the amount and transfers it to the manager after the stay. If the manager declines or the booking is cancelled, 97% of the amount is refunded (3% cancellation fee, shared between the platform and the manager).

items.question: How do I list my property as a manager?
items.answer: Create a manager account, complete the property details (city, price, amenities, photos) and publish the listing. Every photo is checked automatically: only interior or exterior photos are accepted, with no people visible.

items.question: Why does my manager account need verification?
items.answer: Verification (ID document and selfie) reassures travelers and unlocks property management: messaging, booking handling and a trust badge. Until the account is verified, bookings for your properties are handled by the administrator.

items.question: How can I make my listing more visible?
items.answer: The Premium subscription (5,000 XOF per month) adds a badge and pushes one of your listings to the top of search results in your market.

items.question: How do I leave a review after a stay?
items.answer: From your client area, you can post one review per confirmed booking. Your rating and comment are then displayed on the property page to help other travelers.
